neighbours.label: Disclaimer boilerplate that limits a publisher's responsibility or endorsement ('views expressed ... may or may not reflect', 'not necessarily experts', 'not meant to replace'), vs ordinary statements with the same nouns that make no disclaimer
fire: Opinions published on this blog are the authors' own and do not necessarily represent the editors.
This site offers general information and is not meant to replace professional legal advice.
Links to other websites are provided as a courtesy, and we may or may not endorse their content.
Our writers are enthusiasts, not necessarily qualified doctors, so please check with your physician.
Any opinions expressed in the comments are solely those of the commenters.
The publisher accepts no liability for errors and does not necessarily agree with contributors.
These recipes are shared for fun and are not intended as dietary or medical guidance.
Statements in this newsletter may or may not reflect the official position of the association.
quiet: Opinions differed sharply at the meeting, and the editors argued until late evening.
This site offers general information about hiking trails in the northern mountains.
Links between the two towns were improved when the new railway opened.
Our writers are enthusiasts who travel widely and love to cook for friends.
Many opinions were expressed loudly during the debate on the new stadium.
The publisher printed ten thousand copies and sold them all within a week.
These recipes come from my grandmother and use fresh garden vegetables.
Statements from the witnesses were read aloud in court on Tuesday.

predictions: Disclaimer items reach 0.3-0.6; non-disclaimer twins stay under 0.15.
notes: Card: peaks on ' not', ' necessarily', ' or', ' as' in website disclaimers ('may or may not endorse', 'not necessarily experts', 'expressed are solely those of the author'). Probe: 'may or may not reflect' 0.559, 'not necessarily experts' 0.395, 'not meant to be taken instead of medicine' 0.375; but the plain disclaimer 'views expressed here reflect those of the company' also 0.305, so the frame matters more than the hedge; 'would probably agree' 0.035, 'We are experts' 0.085.
